name: John Darling
source:
Wendy’s younger brother, but not related by blood.

He has a sharp mind and excels in school, but is not helpful when accidents arises. He also has a serious side, and lacks flexibility.

For some reason, he doesn’t like sweet things, and particularly hates pudding.

Dotes upon his younger brother, Michael, and looks up to his sister, Wendy.

[From [url=http://appleforest.livejournal.com/4145.html]Appleforest at Livejournal[/url]]
